author: audit (t_36cc607c)
scope: serial (non-drafting) CUDA forward architecture for the 0731 checkpoint, comparing the TensorFold deepseek_v4 MLX reference against the installed Entrpi/ds4 donor

references.reference: src/tensorfold/families/deepseek_v4/{config.py, model.py, attention.py, caches.py, compressor.py, moe.py, weights.py, dense.py, runtime.py}

model_structure.finding: IDENTICAL on both sides; both read the architecture from GGUF metadata (deepseek4.* keys) / checkpoint config
model_structure.contract: Adopt the donor shape reader as authoritative for the serial build; keep the TensorFold config dataclass in sync.

fields.mtp: donor reads optional mtp.* head tensors; TensorFold 0731 serial reference does not use MTP

model_structure.tolerances: Architecture integers must match exactly across reference, donor, and the 0731 GGUF. A mismatch is a hard validation failure.

tensor_layout.finding: SAME tensor set and quant scheme on both sides
tensor_layout.contract: Per-layer tensor names and quant types are fixed by the 0731 GGUF layout; the serial build must read exactly this set.
tensor_layout.tolerances: Tensor names, shapes, and quant types must match the 0731 GGUF exactly. Any tensor the serial build maps differently is a hard failure.

kv_cache.reference: MLX: per-attention compressed pools (raw sliding-window ring + ratio-compressed pool + indexer pool), bf16/fp32 tensors, host/GPU managed
kv_cache.donor: device-resident slabs: raw_cache (sliding window), comp_cache (ratio-pooled), index_comp_cache (indexer pool), with optional packed FP8 compressed KV (DS4_CUDA_FP8_KV) and FP4 activation quant (DS4_CUDA_FP4_ACT)
kv_cache.contract: Adopt the donor slab geometry (raw_cache / comp_cache / index_comp_cache) as the serial cache contract.

precision.opt_in: FP8 packed compressed KV (DS4_CUDA_FP8_KV) and FP4 activation (DS4_CUDA_FP4_ACT) are OPT-IN ONLY; disabled for the first serial release
precision.tolerance_fp8: e4m3 max absolute error on packed values; top-1 logit margin must stay >= preregistered threshold
precision.tolerance_fp4: e2m1 max absolute error on activations; top-1 logit margin >= preregistered threshold

kv_cache.tolerances: Exact path must reproduce the reference cache math bitwise (same compression ratios, same indexer top-k selection). FP8/FP4 paths are declared-lossy and gated on operator evidence (T19), not presumed exact.

attention.algorithm: sliding-window 128 + ratio-compressor (per-layer compress_ratios) + sparse indexer top-k over the compressed pool, with hash-layer routing (num_hash_layers=3)
attention.contract: Implement in CUDA per the donor kernel set: raw SWA read, compressor emit, indexer top-k read. Keep the reference attention math (fp32 accumulation, exact masking) in the serial path.
attention.tolerances: Exactness gate R6: token/state equality must be bitwise vs the trusted fixture oracle. No numerical tolerance substitutes for this gate. Cross-runtime (ds4 CUDA vs MLX) bitwise equality is NOT presumed (plan note); self-consistency plus fixture-oracle equality is the gate.

serial_execution_path.reference: Python/MLX compiled per-row decode: per-layer loop, mx.compile per-row kernels, mx.async_eval pipeline
serial_execution_path.donor: C/CUDA per-layer decode loop over the slab cache with a token-stable scalar substrate (per-layer scalars), optional cudaGraph capture/replay (DS4_CUDA_LAYER_GRAPHS, DS4_CUDA_CONT_CAPTURE)
serial_execution_path.contract: Adopt the donor serial eager per-layer loop as the first release. Drafting (MTP / multi-token prediction) and cudaGraph capture are OUT OF SCOPE for R3 (serial, no drafting).

gates.R3: serial only, one request, no drafting
gates.G11: window/compress/indexer equality tests required before enabling graph capture

serial_execution_path.tolerances: Serial eager path must be deterministic and bitwise-reproducible across runs under fixed seeds and fixed GPU. Graph-capture paths are opt-in only and require G11 equality evidence first.

hardware_dependent_pending.note: All CUDA kernel / slab-residency claims are unverified until T16 runs on the target (GB10).
FP8 KV / FP4 activation lossiness and full-model residency (81 GiB-class) are gated on T19 operator evidence; not presumed exact.
FP8 packed compressed-KV requires virtual-memory demand-mapping on target; unverified until T16/T19.

decision_summary: Keep donor model structure and tensor layout as authoritative (identical to 0731 GGUF).
Adopt donor slab KV-cache geometry; fp32 exact path is the release default.
FP8-KV and FP4-activation are declared opt-in, lossy, and PENDING T19.
Adopt donor serial eager per-layer loop for R3; drafting (MTP) and graph capture are out of scope.
Exactness = bitwise fixture-oracle equality (R6); cross-runtime bitwise is not presumed.
CUDA claims are PENDING until T16 (target) and T19 (full-model operator evidence).
